scope: Provisional adoption of the exact retained-WLC-base-plus-light candidate; not autograph recovery or application approval

english_review_record.section: Concrete Isaiah candidate and identity-blinded English review
english_review_record.role: Previously recorded anonymous sentence comparison, not a second independent manuscript witness

source_decision: Including light is a defensible provisional working preference given two complete-word published Hebrew attestations. The reported proto-MT relationship of 1QIsa-b gives its agreement relevance beyond counting. An explanatory expansion shared through transmission remains a serious alternative. Neither an omission mechanism nor independent witness genealogy is established. This preference does not depend on unestablished precise chronological weighting.
composition_decision: The candidate distinguishes supplied following-verb letters in 1QIsa-b, uncertain and supplied letters in 4Q58, and the Greek's different causative construction. It imports neither other conjunctions nor their verb forms or Greek syntax wholesale. The remaining WLC base analysis is retained, not freshly adjudicated at every unit.
disclosure_decision: Footnote a adequately discloses the editorial inclusion, named Hebrew support, partial third support, Masoretic omission, different Greek construction and uncertainty about earlier wording. The contrary expansion explanation remains in the theological rationale and evidence report; it need not all fit in the footnote.
english_decision: The full sentence is defensible under the declared base analysis and matches the wording preferred in the recorded independent English assessment. Light avoids an unsupported addition of life or an explicit resurrection claim. The correctly anchored knowledge note preserves the consequential alternative interpretation.
metadata_decision: No material contradiction found in active lexical decisions. The objectless-MT verb rationale and he-himself mismatch were corrected. Theologically weighty, theologically established and vicarious burden-bearing remain interpretive phrasing in carried rationales, but do not contradict the candidate or independently decide its source. HALOT references are explicitly not fresh consultations. Internally inconsistent historical revision explanations remain history, not current certification.
retained_cautions: Knowledge-phrase attachment and many versus the many remain interpretive cautions, not prerequisites for this bounded adoption.
This review assumes the evidence report's published-reading findings; it does not freshly inspect parchment or certify exhaustive witness coverage.
Full-record approval is scoped to the specified candidate and retained-base analysis, not every alternative construction in the chapter.
